Baking Association of Canada January 28, 2025 Press Releases Lyon, France – Team Japan won the gold medal at the Sirha Lyon Pastry World Cup in Lyon, France. Team France and Team Malaysia earning silver and bronze medals respectively. The defending champions, the Japanese team achieved the double and thus retained its world championship title, driven by the know-how and talent of Masanaori Hata (chocolate candidate), Yuji Matoba (sugar candidate) and Ryu Miyazaki (ice-cream candidate). Already the winner of the Asia selection last year, Japan is increasingly asserting itself as one of the world’s leading pastry countries, organizers of the competition said in a news release. results.title: South Korean Team Conquers Bakery World Cup With 1.4m Turtle Ship Bread
excerpts: /Jang Gyoung-sik A turtle ship has appeared in Paris, France. It was at the “Bakery World Cup” (Coupe du Monde de la Boulangerie), where the South Korean national team claimed victory on the 21st of last month (local time). Organized biennially since 1992 by the French Bakery and Pastry Confederation, this competition is one of the largest in the baking industry. South Korea’s victory marks the first in 10 years since 2016. The winner is determined through a comprehensive evaluation of three categories: bread artistry, baguettes, and viennoiserie (soft breads made with eggs, butter, etc.). excerpts:
The podium
The 19th edition of the Pastry World Cup concluded with Japan’s victory, celebrating the talent and technical mastery of its team in this Grand Finale. France and Malaysia completed the podium, winning silver and bronze, respectively. As the reigning champion, the Japanese team achieved a remarkable feat by retaining its world title, driven by the expertise of Masanori Hata (chocolate candidate), Yuji Matoba (sugar candidate), and Ryu Miyazaki (ice candidate). After winning the Asia selection last year, Japan further cements its status as a leading force in the world of pastry. Pictures: Nicolas REYNAUD for CMP Or / Japon Silver / France Bronze / Malaysia
